metadata.title: March 14, 2008 - Wherein the Green
metadata.author: By Dan Fisher / Edited by Mike Shenk

entries.clue: In jail for scalping Packers tickets?
Comics character with Dinny the dinosaur
Days of yore, in days of yore
"Plant flower bulbs in the fall," say?
City whose natives are called Loiners
"When I Come Around" getting heavy play on MTV?
Attend a national party in Nuuk without an invitation?
Citizenship and Immigration Services head office?
Scraps of a torn dollar bill?
World's largest maker of farm equipment
Where to find some glass panels?
